Lydia (Beacon): Hi! Ready to start a 7-day POC. Need a billing project with $750 credits, hard spend cap $750, 3 ephemeral dev keys (24h), and a tiny Dedicated node (1xA10G) in us-east-1 behind VPC peering. Also want a model whitelist to prevent large-family models.

Carmen R: Got it. We'll provision billing + credits and set the hard cap. Who signs the spend ack? Also which Slack channel for alerts?

Lydia (Beacon): I will sign (lydia@beacon.ai). Send alerts to #beacon-poc.

Devon (SE): We can issue 24h ephemeral keys and an optional CI service key. Recommend whitelist: ["quant-ggml-*","mini-llama-*"]. We can also set per-route quotas so CI only calls embeddings.

Isha B: Infra needs your VPC CIDR and AWS account id to create peering. We'll enable flow logs with 90d retention. INF-9001 opened.

Lydia (Beacon): VPC CIDR 10.77.0.0/16, AWS acct 444333222111. Confirm flow logs to our S3: arn:aws:s3:::beacon-logs.

InfraBot: INF-9001 created: Dedicated 1xA10G us-east-1 + VPC peering. Waiting on bucket policy confirmation.

Carmen R: Sending spend ack to lydia@beacon.ai. Action items: Carmen apply credits & cap; Devon create 3 dev keys (24h) + CI embeddings-only key; Isha progress INF-9001 and add flow logs; Lydia sign ack.

Lydia (Beacon): Signed and returned.

Carmen R: Credits applied $750 and hard cap enforced. Soft alert at 75% posted to #beacon-poc.

Devon (SE): Dev keys created and DM'd securely. CI key created with embeddings-only scope and IP allowlist. Model whitelist and per-route quotas applied.

Isha B: Peering complete; flow logs delivery confirmed. Dedicated node provisioned. Please validate connectivity from your VPC.

Lydia (Beacon): Can reach endpoint and running smoke tests. Dev keys work. Thanks!

Carmen R: Great — closing loop. Reopen if anything else blocks.
